request.text: By the heir's word, to every outpost on the south roads. Watch for smoke where no village stands. Do not fight whoever carries an ember. Leave them food: a carrier who eats well walks further. Seen anyone with a glowing coal in their hand? Nothing, he says. Take his purse for the lie. There! The ember! Take it! The road's long, finder. Nobody would blame you for sitting a while.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Male, 40-50. Excellent quality. Persona: a disciplined officer of a grey-clad cult that serves a would-be king; a zealot who believes the world should be watched. Emotion: cold, controlled, contemptuous, quietly fanatical. A hard, clipped, level voice with a dry edge, used to giving orders and reading them out; flat calm that turns to a sharp bark when he shouts.
